Create, rename and delete folders

## Usage

```text
chainmail folder
```

## Flags

```text
      --account string   the account the folder is on (required)
```

## Global flags

```text
      --output string   output format: json or table (default $CHAINMAIL_OUTPUT, then cli.toml, then table on a terminal, json otherwise)
      --socket string   daemon socket (default $CHAINMAIL_SOCKET, then cli.toml, then /run/chainmail/chainmail.sock)
```

## Commands

- [chainmail folder create](./chainmail-folder-create.md): Create a folder, and its parents when missing
- [chainmail folder delete](./chainmail-folder-delete.md): Delete a folder; INBOX and role folders are refused (disabled unless policy allows it)
- [chainmail folder rename](./chainmail-folder-rename.md): Rename a folder
